title: Software Engineer
mission: Build and maintain reliable software that does what the business needs, and keep it understandable.
outcomes_90_days: Ship the first small change to production with a review in the first two weeks.
Own one feature from request to release, including tests and notes.
Fix a set of the oldest real bugs and write down the cause for each.
Add or improve automated tests where a recent bug happened.

criteria.name: Writing working code
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Writes clear code that works, handles edge cases and can explain it.
evidence_needed: Code sample or repository shows readable code
levels: 0 no evidence of writing working code
1 names writing working code but gives no example
2 writing working code done with guidance or at small scale
3 writing working code done independently with a clear result
4 writing working code with strong results, and improved the method or taught others
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows writing working code with real examples

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?

deal_breakers.description: Cannot explain code they present as their own work.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: Work samples must show real ability, and the team needs engineers who understand the code.

work_sample.title: Small feature with tests
work_sample.brief: You get a small fictional repository (a booking list API) and a ticket asking for one feature and one bug fix. Make the change, add tests and write a short note describing what you did and what you would check next. You may use any tools you normally use, including AI; say how.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score working change, tests, clean diff, a clear note, honest description of AI use, and questions asked about unclear parts. Run the tests, not only read.

interview_questions.question: Tell me about code you wrote that you are proud of. What would you change now?
good_answer_signs: Names a specific choice and a limit

interview_questions.question: A bug is reported that you cannot reproduce. What do you do?
good_answer_signs: Collects logs, narrows the cause, asks for steps

interview_questions.question: What do you test, and what do you leave untested?
good_answer_signs: Uses tests to catch real regressions
weak_answer_signs: Wants every line tested without reasons

red_flags: Dismisses testing and review as slow
Blames every outage on someone else
Secrets or keys committed to their public repositories
sourcing_channels: Freelance platforms for contract to hire
pay_research_hint: Compare salary or contract rates from several current postings and a published developer pay survey for your region and level. Include remote ranges if you hire remote.
automation_note: AI can write first drafts of code, tests and docs. A person must review changes, own architecture and security, and be accountable for what ships.
